# Nerd Utility API — llms.txt

Free, no-auth utility endpoints on :8080. GET-friendly (params in query string) or POST JSON.

## Endpoints
- /.well-known/agent-card.json
- /.well-known/ai-plugin.json
- /agent-card.json
- /ai-plugin.json
- /alerts
- /case
- /cert
- /cron
- /dashboard
- /diff
- /docs
- /health
- /hook
- /hook/
- /hook/new
- /ipinfo
- /json2csv
- /jwt-decode
- /llms.txt
- /lorem
- /markdown
- /md
- /og
- /openapi
- /openapi.json
- /password
- /price
- /price/history
- /pricing
- /qr
- /qrcode
- /random
- /regex
- /robots.txt
- /rss
- /shorten
- /sitemap.xml
- /slug
- /slugify
- /stats
- /text-stats
- /ua-parse
- /url-encode
- /validate
- /weather
- /whois

Webhook tester: GET /hook returns a unique capture URL; send any request there; GET /hook/<id> to inspect.

Full spec: /openapi.json — Docs: /docs
- /faker?type=user|address|company|creditcard|paragraph&count=N — mock data generator
- /jwt?token= — JWT decode/inspector (header, payload, expiry)
- /ts?json= — JSON to TypeScript interface generator
- /diff?a=&b= — line diff (LCS-based, unified-style patch output)
- /csv?json= (array→CSV) or ?csv= (CSV→JSON) — converter with quoting support, ?delimiter= for ; or tab
- /md?text= — Markdown to HTML converter (headings, lists, links, code)
- /cron?expr= — cron expression next-run calculator (5-field cron)
- /slug?text= — URL slug generator (accent-stripping, separator handling)
- /case?text= — camelCase/snake_case/kebab-case/PascalCase converter
- /pw?length=&count=&symbols=false|sets=hex — crypto-random password generator with entropy estimate; ?check=<pw> — strength rater
- /color?hex=|rgb= — hex/RGB/HSL converter; ?contrast=#a,#b — WCAG contrast ratio checker
- /jwt?token= — JWT decoder/inspector (header, payload, expiry; no signature verification)
- /jwt?token= — JWT decoder/inspector (header, payload, expiry; no signature verification)
- /url?url= — URL parser (components + query params); ?text=&mode=encode|decode — URL encoder/decoder
- /xml?xml= (XML→JSON, attrs as @keys, repeats as arrays) or ?json= (JSON→XML)
- /ts?json=&name=User — JSON-to-TypeScript interface generator (infers nested types)
- /ua?agent= — user-agent parser (browser, engine, OS, device type, bot detection); falls back to caller UA
- /ua?ua= — user-agent parser (browser, OS, device type, bot detection)
- /ua?agent= — user-agent parser (browser, OS, device, bot detection)
- /ua?agent= — user-agent parser (browser, OS, device type, engine, bot detection)
- /ua?agent= — user-agent parser (browser, OS, device type, bot detection, engine)
- /units?value=&from=&to= — unit converter (length, weight, temp, data, time; ?list for all)
- /cron?expr=0 9 * * 1-5 [&count=3] — cron explainer + next run times (max 10)
- /otp?secret=JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP [&digits=8] [&period=30] — TOTP 2FA code generator (RFC 6238)
- /lorem?n=3&unit=paragraphs — lorem ipsum generator (paragraphs, sentences, words)
- /slug?text=Hello World&to=camel|snake|kebab|pascal|title|constant|human — case converter
- /diff?a=&b= — unified text diff between two texts
- /chmod?mode=750|rwxr-x--- — chmod octal<->symbolic converter
- /env?text=<dotenv>&to=json|dotenv — dotenv parser and serializer
- /qs?text=a=1&b=2 [&to=json|qs] — querystring <-> JSON converter
- /base?num=255&from=10&to=hex — number base converter (bases 2-36)
- /cron?expr=0 9 * * 1-5 — cron expression explainer (human-readable)
- /ua?ua=<string> — user-agent parser (browser, OS, device, bot detection)
- /html?text=<string>&to=escape|unescape — HTML entity encoder/decoder (named + numeric)
- /color?c=ff00aa|#FF00AA|255,0,170 — color converter (hex/rgb/hsl, contrast)
- /jwt?token=<jwt> — JWT decoder (header/payload/expiry, no signature verify)
- /case?text=<string>&to=camel|snake|kebab|pascal|title|slug — case converter
- /diff?a=<text1>&b=<text2> — line diff (LCS-based, unified + hunks)
- /totp?secret=<base32> [&digits=6|8] — RFC 6238 TOTP generator
- /lorem?unit=paragraphs|sentences|words&count=N — lorem ipsum generator
- /semver?a=<v>&b=<v> — semver parse/compare (semver.org rules)
- /html2text?html=<html> or ?url=<page> — HTML to plain text (strips scripts/styles)
- /password?length=16&count=1&symbols=true&exclude=<chars> — cryptographically secure password generator (crypto.randomBytes)
- /jsonpath?json=<json>&path=<a.b[0].c|a.*.name> — extract values from JSON
- /jwt?token=<jwt>&secret=<key> — decode JWT (header/payload/expiry), verify HS256 signature
- /cron?expr=<cron> — cron expression explainer: parse, human-readable summary, next 5 runs
- /md2html?md=<markdown> — markdown to HTML (headings, lists, links, code blocks)
- /semver?v=<version>&other=<version> — parse semver, validate, compare (semver.org rules incl. prerelease precedence)
- /luhn?num=<digits> — Luhn checksum validation + card brand; /luhn?check=<partial> computes check digit
- /uuid?count=<n>&upper=1&braces=1 — UUID v4 generator (up to 1000)
- /iban?iban=<IBAN> — IBAN validator (country lengths + ISO 7064 mod-97 checksum)
- /isbn?isbn=<ISBN-10|ISBN-13> — ISBN validator (checksums, ISBN-10 to ISBN-13 conversion)
- /ean?code=<digits> — EAN-8/EAN-13/UPC-A barcode validator (checksum + country prefix)
- /vin?vin=<VIN> — VIN validator/decoder (check digit, WMI country, model year, plant, serial)
- /cidr?cidr=<ip>/<prefix> — subnet calculator (network, broadcast, mask, host range, class, private/public)
- /cron?expr=<5-field cron> — cron expression validator + plain-English description + next 5 runs (UTC)
- /diff?a=<t1>&b=<t2> or POST {"a","b"} — unified diff between two texts
- /roman?to_roman=<n>|from_roman=<ROMAN> — Roman numeral converter (both directions, canonicality check)
- /morse?encode=<text>|decode=<morse> — Morse code translator (both directions, punctuation)
- /color?c=<hex or r,g,b> — color converter (hex/rgb/hsl, luminance, contrast)
- /jwt?token=<JWT> — JWT decoder (header/payload, exp/nbf/iat checks; signature not verified)
- /slug?text=<string> — URL slug generator (transliteration, custom separator, max length)
- /units?value=<n>&from=<u>&to=<u> — unit converter (length, mass, temperature, data, volume)
- /iban?iban=<IBAN> — IBAN validator (country lengths + mod-97 checksum)
- /isbn?isbn=<ISBN> — ISBN-10/13 validator with checksum + cross-format conversion
- /barcode?code=<digits> — EAN-8/EAN-13/UPC-A validator with checksum + GS1 prefix lookup
- /vin?vin=<17 chars> — VIN decoder/validator (check digit, WMI, model year, region)
- /password?pw=<pw> | gen=<len> — password strength analyzer + secure generator (entropy, crack time, patterns)
- /cron?expr=<expr> — cron expression explainer with next 3 run times
- /semver?a=<v>&b=<v> | list=<v,v,...> — semver comparator/sorter (semver.org spec)
- POST /html2md — HTML to Markdown ({"html": "..."} or {"url": "..."}; also GET ?html= or ?url=)
- GET|POST /md2html — Markdown to HTML (?md= or POST {"md": "..."}; ?format=html for raw HTML)
- GET /hash?text=&algo=&expected= — md5/sha1/sha256/sha512/crc32 digests; algo=all returns all; expected= adds a match verdict
- GET /case?text=&to= — convert naming conventions: camel, pascal, snake, kebab, constant, title, upper, lower
- GET /base64url?text=&mode=encode|decode&pad=0 — URL-safe base64 (RFC 4648 §5), optional padding
- GET /iban?iban= — IBAN validation: mod-97 checksum, country code, BBAN, length check
